description: Static onboarding guide for connecting local LLMs to MMIR.ai through a safe local connector. The actual connector is owned by the backend track.

steps.title: Install local connector
steps.description: Download a small MMIR connector app or script from the backend project. It should run locally and expose only a controlled connector API, not raw model runtimes.

steps.title: Detect local models
steps.description: The connector discovers supported local runtimes such as Ollama and returns available models through the MMIR /models contract.

steps.title: Connect to MMIR.ai
steps.description: The frontend stores only a local connector URL and safe profile metadata. Secrets and provider credentials remain outside the public frontend.

steps.title: Chat safely
steps.description: MMIR routes chat requests through the connector contract. Raw Ollama port 11434 should not be exposed publicly.

security: No secrets in GitHub Pages frontend
Local connector should require explicit local user action
Allow users to disconnect and delete local profiles
